map.盘旋（转弯）性能：角速度 ω = g·tanφ ÷ v，φ 为坡度角、v 为真空: Turning (turn) performance: angular velocity ω = g·tanφ ÷ v, where φ is the bank angle and v the true airspeed; turn rate = ω × 180 ÷ π (°/s); turn radius R = v² ÷ (g·tanφ); load factor n = 1 ÷ cosφ; the steeper the bank, the faster the turn but the higher the load.
map.与转弯半径互为倒易。: It is the reciprocal of the turn radius.
map.战斗机追求高转弯率。: Fighters pursue a high turn rate.
map.ω=g·tanφ/V，由速度与坡度求转弯快慢。: ω=g·tanφ/V, finding how fast the turn is from the speed and bank.
map.对比不同速度下的转弯率，规划标准速率转弯。: Compare the turn rate at different speeds to plan a standard rate turn.
map.评估机动中单位时间转过的角度是否满足避障。: Assess whether the angle turned per unit time in a manoeuvre satisfies obstacle avoidance.
Speed V=100 m/s and bank φ=30°. ω=g·tanφ/V=9.81×0.577/100≈0.0566 rad/s ≈ 3.24°/s. Close to the civil aviation standard rate turn (3°/s), suitable for instrument approach procedures.
map.转弯率和转弯半径什么关系？: What is the relationship between turn rate and turn radius?
map.ω=V/R，半径越小或速度越大角速度越大。本工具由 V 与 φ 直接算 ω；与转: ω=V/R: the smaller the radius or the higher the speed, the greater the angular velocity. This tool computes ω directly from V and φ; it complements the turn radius tool (one looks at how fast to turn, the other at how big a circle to turn).
map.速度越慢转弯率越大吗？: Does a lower speed give a higher turn rate?
map.对，ω∝1/V。同一坡度低速转得更快（角速度大），但半径也更小。低速大坡度易超结: Yes, ω is proportional to 1/V. At the same bank a lower speed turns faster (higher angular velocity) but with a smaller radius. A low speed with a steep bank easily exceeds the structural load, so the load factor limit must be checked at the same time.
